name: OATS
author: OATS Framework
description: OATS on Omarchy: an OATS icon in the bar whose panel shows the agents waiting on you as cards, read when you open it, and opens their sessions, the TUI and the Desktop; a setup script for launchers, keys, and the OATS row in SUPER + SPACE that opens the default UI; omarchy-launch-oats and the agent key, which open the machine's steward; and omarchy-install-oats, which installs OATS and hands over to an onboarding agent.

barWidget.description: A panel, read fresh each time it opens, that shows the agents waiting on you and opens their sessions, the OATS TUI and Desktop, and setup.
